speaker: Keisha Ramos
cascadeSummary: Published the Phase II shortlist per C103 deliverable schedule, reducing qualified builders from four to three. This maintains project momentum while meeting CRC transparency demands.

statements.quote: Three qualified consortiums advance to the final proposal phase—we're building Baylight with the teams that can deliver.
statements.fullStatement: Baylight Authority Director Keisha Ramos confirmed publication of the Phase II shortlist, narrowing the field from four pre-qualified bidding consortiums to three finalists. The selection criteria evaluated construction capacity, local workforce commitments, and phased delivery timelines. 'This keeps us on track for groundbreaking within two cycles,' Ramos noted. The Authority will host public presentations from the finalists before awarding the prime contract.

trackerUpdates.MilestoneNotes: C103: Phase II shortlist published (4→3 qualified bidders)
trackerUpdates.NextScheduledAction: Finalist presentations and prime contract award

statements.quote: Every dollar of the $2.1B budget will be accounted for—starting with these scoring sheets.
statements.fullStatement: In response to CRC records requests, the Baylight Authority published the complete vendor evaluation matrix showing how the four pre-qualified bidders were scored on financial capacity (30%), Oakland hire commitments (25%), union compliance (20%), schedule feasibility (15%), and environmental remediation experience (10%). Director Keisha Ramos noted the scoring aligns with BD-83-TIF workforce requirements and BD-83-REB cleanup standards. 'Transparency builds trust in the process,' Ramos said. The evaluation documents are available through the City Clerk's office.
